plugin.name: LayOut
plugin.description: Sheets for plans next to the 3D model: viewports from scenes with a drawing scale, live linked to the model, 2D drawing tools, dimensions, labels, a library of floor plan symbols, title block, SVG export, presentation and printing to PDF.

layout.fromScenesTitle: A new sheet with up to four scenes as viewports – parallel scenes get a drawing scale that fits
layout.empty: No sheets yet. Start with an empty sheet or put the scenes of the model on one.
layout.hint: Viewports show their scene live – change the model or the scene and the sheet follows. Double-click a viewport to open its view in the model.

tools.label: Label
tools.selectTitle: Select (Shift adds, drag a frame for several), move, pull handles – Delete removes, Ctrl+G groups
tools.styleTitle: Click an element to pick up its style, then click others to apply it
tools.viewportTitle: Draw a frame for a view of the model
tools.imageTitle: Click where an image from a file goes
tools.labelTitle: Drag from the point to where the text goes – a leader line with text
tools.dimensionTitle: Drag from point to point – on a scaled viewport it measures the model
tools.angleTitle: Click the vertex, then a point on each leg
tools.freehandTitle: Draw freely while the button is held
tools.arcTitle: Drag from the centre to the start, then click the end
tools.arc2Title: Drag from start to end, then click how far it bulges
tools.pieTitle: Like an arc, closed to the centre
tools.roundedTitle: Drag a rectangle with rounded corners
tools.lozengeTitle: Drag a rectangle with fully round ends
tools.bulgedTitle: Drag a rectangle with bulging sides
tools.ellipseTitle: Drag the box of the ellipse
tools.polygonTitle: Drag from the centre outwards – the number of sides is in the toolbar
tools.offsetTitle: Click an element – a copy at the distance appears on the side of the click
tools.filletTitle: Click two lines – they meet with a rounded corner
tools.chamferTitle: Click two lines – they meet with a cut corner
tools.trimTitle: Click the part of a line to cut away up to the next crossing lines
tools.extendTitle: Click near the end of a line to extend it to the next line
tools.splitTitle: Click a line, path or rectangle where it should be split

status.select: Click to select (Shift adds), drag a frame around several, drag to move, pull a handle to resize. R rotates, M mirrors, arrows nudge.
status.style: Click the element whose style you want to pick up.
status.styleApply: Click elements to give them the style – Esc ends.
status.viewport: Drag a frame – it shows the first scene; choose another one on the right.
status.image: Click where the image goes, then choose the file.
status.label: Drag from the point the label refers to towards where the text goes.
status.dimension: Drag from the first to the second point. Shift keeps it horizontal or vertical.
status.angle: Click the vertex, then one point on each leg.
status.line: Drag the line. Shift keeps it horizontal or vertical.
status.arc: Drag from the centre to the start of the arc.
status.arc2: Drag from the start to the end of the arc.
status.pie: Drag from the centre to the start of the pie.
status.arcBulge: Click how far the arc bulges.
status.rounded: Drag the rectangle – the corner radius can be changed on the right.
status.ellipse: Drag the box of the ellipse.
status.offset: Click an element on the side the copy should appear.
status.trim: Click the part of the line to cut away.
status.extend: Click near the end of the line to extend.
status.split: Click where the element should be split.
status.symbol: Click where “{name}” ({size} m) goes – on a scaled viewport it takes its scale.
status.nothingToReach: No line in that direction to extend to.
status.cannotJoinCorner: The lines do not meet in a corner (or the distance is too large).

viewport.takeViewTitle: The viewport shows the view of the 3D model as it is now (no scene)
viewport.preserveScaleTitle: Off: resizing the frame keeps the part of the model and changes the scale
viewport.caption: Title
viewport.noSections: The model has no section planes yet – add one with the Section Plane tool in the model.

actions.groupTitle: Make one element of the selection (Ctrl+G)
actions.joinTitle: Lines and paths that touch become one path
actions.joinFailed: The selected lines do not touch end to end.

dimension.paper: Measures the paper (not on a scaled viewport).

layers.title: Layers
layers.activeTitle: Click: new elements go on this layer · double-click: rename
layers.name: Name of the layer
layers.removeConfirm: Delete the layer “{name}”? Its elements go to the bottom layer.
layers.lockedActive: The active layer is locked – unlock it or choose another one.

templates.title: New sheet from a template
templates.addTitle: A new sheet (from the default template)
templates.saveTitle: Keep this sheet with everything on it as a template for new sheets – in every model
templates.none: No templates yet – “Save as template” on a sheet adds one.
templates.name: Name of the template
